about: A part's parameters: one kind per part and the fields of that kind, in the units below with no prefix (100nF is 1e-07). `cloud-parts find` searches these. A field the datasheet does not state is left out, and the table says so in its `null_reason`.

types.num: a number in the field's unit
types.range: [min, max] in the field's unit; null for an end the datasheet does not state. A single maximum (an LDO's 'Voltage - Supply: 15V') is [null, 15]
types.cond: a list of {"value": number, <condition>: number}: the value at a stated test condition, one entry per condition the datasheet gives (rds_on at vgs 10 and at 4.5). A value the datasheet gives with no condition has the condition null
types.enums: a list of the listed words

kind.desc: what the part is; one of `kinds`

mount.desc: how it lands on the board

temp.desc: operating (or junction, when that is all that is given) temperature

channels.desc: independent units in the package: amps in a dual op amp, FETs in a dual FET, lines on a TVS array

resistor.desc: fixed resistor, chip or leaded, including current-sense shunts and resistor arrays (channels = elements)

potentiometer.desc: variable resistor: panel pot, trimmer, slide pot

shaft_length.desc: from the mounting face; slide pots: travel

dielectric.desc: the ceramic class (C0G is also NP0), or the technology for anything not ceramic

lifetime.desc: rated hours at the top of its temperature range (electrolytics)

tolerance_abs.desc: ± in farads, for small C0G parts rated ±0.25pF

ripple_frequency.desc: the frequency ripple_current and esr are given at

inductor.desc: inductor or coil: power, RF, coupled

q.desc: quality factor at a test frequency; one entry per frequency the datasheet gives (JLC: 'Q @ Frequency')

tolerance_abs.desc: ± in henries, for small RF inductors rated ±0.3nH rather than in %

impedance.desc: common-mode, at 100 MHz unless the datasheet gives only another

transformer.desc: transformer: RF, signal, current-sense, gate-drive or power (not a common-mode choke)

turns_ratio.desc: secondary turns per primary turn, as the datasheet states it (1:200 is 200)

impedance_ratio.desc: secondary to primary impedance, as the datasheet states it (RF transformers)

freq.desc: the frequency range the datasheet specifies

impedance.desc: the system impedance an RF transformer is specified in (50, 75)

crystal.desc: quartz crystal, resonator or crystal oscillator

oscillator.desc: an active oscillator, not a bare crystal

trip_time.desc: PTC time to trip, at the datasheet's stated current

varistor.desc: MOV or other varistor, surge suppressor that is not a TVS diode

diode.desc: rectifier, Schottky, signal or fast-recovery diode, and diode pairs (not Zener, TVS, LED, bridge)

vf.desc: forward voltage at a forward current

ir_voltage.desc: the reverse voltage ir is given at, when not vr

tvs.desc: TVS diode or ESD protection array

ipp.desc: peak pulse current (8/20 µs unless only 10/1000 is given)

clamp_current.desc: the current clamp is given at, when not ipp

led.desc: LED, single or multi-color, including addressable (built-in driver) LEDs

vf_range.desc: min and max forward voltage, when the datasheet gives a range

bjt.desc: bipolar transistor, single, dual, Darlington or array

channel.desc: n_p: one of each in the package

id.desc: continuous drain current, at 25 °C case unless only ambient is given

rds_on.desc: maximum on-resistance at a gate voltage; one entry per vgs the datasheet gives

vgs_th.desc: gate threshold min and max, as magnitudes

jfet.desc: junction FET, single or dual (matched pairs: channels 2)

idss.desc: zero-gate-voltage drain current, min and max

vgs_off.desc: gate-source cutoff (pinch-off) voltage min and max, as magnitudes

noise.desc: input voltage noise density at 1 kHz

insulated.desc: tab or base insulated from the terminals

opamp.desc: operational amplifier, including precision, FET-input and audio op amps

supply.desc: total supply span (V+ minus V-); ±15 V is [null, 30] or the datasheet's single-supply range

vos.desc: maximum input offset at 25 °C (typical when that is all that is given)

noise.desc: input voltage noise density at 1 kHz

ldo.desc: linear regulator, fixed or adjustable (LDO or not)

vout.desc: fixed output; leave out for an adjustable

psrr.desc: at the lowest frequency given (usually 100 Hz or 1 kHz)

switching_regulator.desc: DC-DC converter or controller: buck, boost, buck-boost, inverting, charge pump, flyback

topology.desc: the main topology; a part that does several (MC34063A) lists the others in also

vout.desc: fixed output; leave out for an adjustable

switch_current.desc: switch current limit, when given instead of iout

fsw.desc: switching frequency; one fixed frequency is [f, f]

integrated_switch.desc: false for a controller that drives an external FET

also.desc: other topologies it can be wired as

polarity.desc: the output's sign: negative for an inverter or a charge-pump inverter (ICL7660: −VIN)

power_switch.desc: load switch, power-distribution switch, eFuse, ideal diode, hot-swap

current.desc: maximum continuous current or current-limit setting

external_fet.desc: a controller that drives external FETs

gain.desc: V/V; leave out for a digital monitor

isolation_amplifier.desc: isolation (isolated) amplifier: an analog signal carried across an isolation barrier

ac_dc.desc: AC-DC controller or switcher IC, or an AC-DC power module

motor_driver.desc: motor driver: H-bridge, stepper, BLDC, gate driver for motors

current.desc: continuous output current per channel (peak when that is all that is given)

rds_on.desc: high plus low side, typical (a characteristic of the driver's bridge, not a FET's guaranteed maximum)

core.desc: lower case, as written: cortex-m0+, cortex-m4, risc-v, avr, 8051, stm8, xtensa

wireless_module.desc: radio module: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, LoRa, cellular, with or without an MCU inside

chip.desc: the SoC inside, lower case: esp32-c3, esp32-s3, nrf52840

rf_amplifier.desc: RF or microwave amplifier: gain block, LNA, driver amplifier

freq.desc: the frequency range the datasheet specifies

gain.desc: small-signal gain at a frequency; one entry per frequency the datasheet's specification table gives

nf.desc: noise figure at a frequency; one entry per frequency the datasheet's specification table gives

p1db.desc: output power at 1 dB compression at a frequency; one entry per frequency the table gives

oip3.desc: output third-order intercept at a frequency; one entry per frequency the table gives

impedance.desc: the system impedance it is matched to (50, 75)

rf_filter.desc: RF filter: LC, ceramic, LTCC, SAW or BAW low-, high-, band-pass or band-stop

passband.desc: pass band (a low-pass from DC is [0, f])

interface.desc: interface IC: transceiver (CAN, RS-485, RS-232, LIN), USB bridge or hub, I/O expander, level shifter, digital isolator, LCD driver

ports.desc: hub downstream ports, expander I/O lines, isolator channels

logic.desc: standard logic: gates, buffers, drivers, flip-flops, counters, shift registers, 555 timers

function.desc: lower case, short: nand, inverter, buffer, d_flip_flop, shift_register, counter, decoder, timer

delay.desc: propagation delay at the typical supply

sensor.desc: sensor IC: magnetic (Hall), temperature, humidity, IMU, pressure, light, current

thermistor.desc: resistor made to follow temperature, used as a sensor: NTC or PTC chip thermistor, platinum resistance sensor (Pt100, Pt500, Pt1000)

ref_temp.desc: the temperature the nominal resistance is stated at: 25 for most thermistors, 0 for a platinum sensor

tolerance.desc: ±, on the nominal resistance at ref_temp, as a positive number; a platinum sensor states a tolerance_class instead

b.desc: B constant between 25 °C and t2, one entry per pair the datasheet gives; the first entry is the pair the part is specified and toleranced over

tcr.desc: a platinum sensor's mean temperature coefficient from 0 to 100 °C (3850 for the IEC 60751 curve)

class_temp.desc: the temperature range the tolerance_class holds over

current_max.desc: largest continuous measuring current the datasheet allows

dissipation_constant.desc: power that warms the part 1 °C above its surroundings (a self-heating figure in K/mW is its inverse)

time_constant.desc: thermal time constant, the datasheet's maximum or typical

audio.desc: audio IC: power amplifier, codec, audio interface

power.desc: output power per channel, at the datasheet's headline load

connector.desc: any connector, header, terminal block, socket or cable-side housing

positions.desc: total contacts that carry signals (shield and mounting pins left out)

series.desc: maker series: jst ph, jst xh, molex picoblade, usb-c, 3.5mm trs

switch.desc: mechanical switch: tactile, push, toggle, slide, DIP, rotary encoder

positions.desc: DIP: number of switches; rotary: positions

voltage.desc: contact rating, the higher of AC and DC

mechanical.desc: no electrical function to search: battery contacts and holders, test points, standoffs, shields, welding terminals, buzzers with no spec worth searching

function.desc: short, lower case: battery_contact, battery_holder, test_point, shield, solder_terminal

other.desc: nothing above fits; say what it is in `function` so a new kind can be made when a few gather

about_kind_aliases: words that name kinds in a search: `cloud-parts find fet vds:30V..`. A kind's own name works too, and a trailing s is dropped. A word given as {kinds, terms} also adds those terms: `schottky` is `diode type:schottky`.
convention: Which figure a field holds where a datasheet gives several. A limit -- an absolute maximum, a guaranteed bound the schema names (rds_on is the maximum, vbr the minimum breakdown, vgs_th the min and max) -- is the guaranteed figure. A characteristic -- ciss, qg, gbw, slew, iq, noise, vos, ib, output_current, psrr, q, intensity, wavelength and the like -- is the typical figure. Where the datasheet gives only one of typical, min or max for a characteristic, that is the figure, named in the value's condition; where it gives min and max but no typical, it is the maximum. A motor driver's rds_on is the typical high plus low side (its desc says so), unlike a MOSFET's rds_on, which is the maximum.
about_word_implies: A filed word that also answers a search for another: a rail-to-rail in_out op amp is rail_to_rail = 'out'; a CAN FD MCU has CAN. Nothing else matches but the word itself.
